verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator. Routing live autonomy failures to an operator intervention queue and handing control back is a fleet-operations or teleoperation capability, outside a simulator's product category. The evidence shows only general building blocks: GUI interaction, transport messaging, plugins and CLI introspection. Nothing shows Gazebo shipping an intervention queue, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can route autonomy failures to a human intervention queue where an operator resolves and hands back control
